Visitor handles custom elements with nested content

```typescript title="TypeScript"

  const _testVisitor = {
    visitCustomElement(ctx: any, tagName: any, html: any): string | { custom: string } {
        return { custom: "[CUSTOM WIDGET]" };

    }
```
